bibliographic.title: Warriors and Dragons
bibliographic.author: Two Schoolmates
bibliographic.description: In this story you are coming home from school (it gets more exiting than that) I can't say much about it here you just have to see. It was all put together by two classmates (one of them is writing this) and it took a whole school semester. The stories are from "Warriors" by Erin Hunter, and "Wings of Fire" by Tui T. Sutherland. Hope you enjoy!

links.title: Warriors and Dragons
links.desc: You enter different realms and you have to escape.
